journeyBrief.title: Send equipment to maintenance
journeyBrief.goal: The manager takes an available equipment out of operation for maintenance, after checking it is not in an active rental contract, so that it cannot be rented while being serviced.

journeyBrief.title: Return equipment from maintenance
journeyBrief.goal: Once maintenance is finished, the manager puts the equipment back into operation so it becomes available for new rentals.
